newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 19.91 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 19.91 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Friday, July 25, was fixed at 19.9100 percent, or a rise of 1.50 basis points from 19.8950 percent, the rate for July 24, Banco de Mexico said on Thursday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Friday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
